description: Zambia - Electrical Transformers And Substations (Point) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Min Jaegal (World Bank Group). The dataset contains the point location of 1)Distribution MVLV Transformers 2)Distribution MV Transformers 3)Distribution Substations 4)HVMV Substations 5)MVLV Substations in Zambia. Coverage: Zambia. It has 4 files in ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
